The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 52c828f91521d93c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The operator f′ of (6.5) is induced by a morphism Rh∗QX −→ Rh∗QX[−2] (7.3) in the constructible derived category on A. Consequently f′ (PkHm (X, Q)) ⊆ Pk−2Hm−2 (X, Q) for all integers m, k.
